cases.expected_answer: The Transformer — a model based entirely on attention mechanisms, with no recurrence or convolution

cases.question: What are the two sub-layers in each encoder layer?
cases.expected_answer: A multi-head self-attention mechanism and a position-wise fully connected feed-forward network

cases.question: What is the purpose of positional encoding?
cases.expected_answer: Injects information about the relative or absolute position of tokens in the sequence, since the model has no recurrence or convolution to capture order

cases.question: What is Scaled Dot-Product Attention, and why is it scaled?
cases.expected_answer: Attention computed as dot products of queries and keys, divided by sqrt(d_k), to counteract dot products growing large in magnitude for large d_k, which would push the softmax into regions with extremely small gradients

cases.question: What is the main motivation for using self-attention instead of recurrent or convolutional layers?
cases.expected_answer: Lower total computational complexity per layer, more computation that can be parallelized, and shorter path length between long-range dependencies in the network

cases.question: How does multi-head attention differ from single-head attention, and why do the authors use multiple heads?
cases.expected_answer: Queries, keys, and values are linearly projected h times into lower-dimensional subspaces and attention is performed in parallel on each; multiple heads let the model jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions, which a single attention head averages away
